Command.Statement: with member [Measures].[Count] as 'Count(CrossJoin([Product].[Product Family].Members, [Time].[Year].Members), EXCLUDEEMPTY)' member [Measures].[Rank] as 'Rank([Product].CurrentMember, [Product].[Product Family].Members, [Measures].[Unit Sales])' member [Measures].[Set] as 'SetToStr(Head(Tail([Product].[Product Family].Members, 3), 2))' select {[Measures].[Unit Sales], [Measures].[Count], [Measures].[Rank], [Measures].[Set]} on 0, [Product].[Product Family].Members on 1 from [ZFMSALES]
